figurative_meaning_en: face to face, in the presence of
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় সকলে সামনাসামনি বসে আলোচনা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: They stood face to face arguing.
Everyone sat face to face in the meeting to discuss.
note: This idiom is a common synonym for direct confrontation or presence in Bengali vernacular.
